HostMap.dc.html.title: Docker-hosted map (this PC or SSH host)

Appliance.dc.html.title: Appliance OS image (VMware, VirtualBox, USB, export)

nMain.text:
Shows: the finished-render card with three share routes beside Open map.
Try: the Stage tweak (finished, hosting, ready) and click a route card.
Unbuilt: target for the render panel.

nPhone.text:
Shows: the ready card at 390 px. Nothing is removed on a phone; route cards stack and actions wrap.
Try: nothing interactive here; it is the parity reference.

nHost.text:
Shows: one-click hosting of the rendered map as a container on this PC or an SSH host.
Try: Target switch, the Stage tweak for progress, ready and failure.
Unbuilt: real progress comes from the main process.

nAppliance.text:
Shows: the appliance with every part bundled; one-click start in VMware or VirtualBox, a bootable USB, or an exported image to install by hand.
Try: the four targets, the USB confirmation, Stage tweak.
Unbuilt: the USB write needs an administrator prompt the user approves.

nLive.text:
Shows: Prismarine Viewer or Prismarine Web Client plus a mineflayer bot, every option a real control.
Try: Viewer kind and sign-in switches, bot behaviour toggles.
Unbuilt: Microsoft sign-in uses the device-code flow; nothing is stored in plain text.

nNbt.text:
Shows: a tree editor for every NBT tag type with typed inline controls, search with regex, and a history panel backed by one Git repository per project.
Try: expand nodes, edit values, the History tab.
Unbuilt: region-file chunk browsing beyond the first level.

nInstances.text:
Shows: every instance this app created, with health checked just now, link, open, copy, logs, stop, remove.
Try: the row actions; Remove names exactly what is deleted.
